question: I have a question about the scene in Arc 9 where Al brings out the Book of the Dead. When Petra read Subaru's Book of the Dead, it only contained memories up to the Sanctuary, but when Al shared the information with the Divine Dragon, I believe the memories that were shared went all the way to the end. Why was that?
answer:
Subaru's Book of the Dead is one of multiple books, each of which records his memories up until the time he died, whereas Al only has one book. Since Al has only one book, he had an incredibly difficult time searching for it. He had to redo things over and over again before finally finding it, and then he used the book he had found in that way.

As for the episode where Al hid Subaru's Book of the Dead, it was a time-delayed trap: “If Petra and Meili find out that there's a book hidden by Al, then naturally they'll search for it and read it.” Of course, even Al doesn't know which of Subaru's deaths the particular book records.

The fact that the book I happened to leave there was specifically the one from the loop where Petra gave Subaru the handkerchief was simply my own malicious intent (laughs). That's basically how it happened.
